sources.snippet: Mistral AI is a French AI company building open source and commercial language models. Their models (Mistral 7B, Mixtral, Mistral Large) offer a compelling alternative to GPT-4 with strong multilingual capabilities, fast inference, and permissive licensing for the open models.
